architecture_authority.decision: A1 is governed by the architecture authority package. It freezes the pure canonical schemas and the one-way legacy reader; downstream assembly, retrieval, projection, prompt, media, approval, and production behavior remain outside A1.

checks.name: canonical_artifact_envelope
checks.evidence: ArtifactEnvelope deep-freezes payloads and dependencies before hashing, binds declared persistent payload types to their canonical ArtifactKind, rejects type-confused envelopes and forged hashes, and permits untyped generic mappings only where a later task has not yet introduced a canonical payload type.

checks.name: canonical_24000_tick_timebase
checks.evidence: CanonicalTimeline accepts only 24000 ticks per second; TickRange is half-open, and each generation segment uses its own local zero-based timeline.

checks.name: draft_artifact_separation
checks.evidence: Episode, scene, B0, and B1 creative Draft schemas contain creative proposals only. IDs, hashes, state-boundary authority, ticks, and final VEC graph authority are assigned by local canonical types.

checks.name: no_duplicate_domain_authority
checks.evidence: The mode_p_vnext.domain package is the single accepted v2.1 type authority, declares one package-wide owner for every canonical type, and assigns one ArtifactKind to every persistent canonical payload. Historical and invalidated service-layer representations do not grant authority.

checks.name: domain_schemas_frozen_for_downstream
checks.evidence: All canonical domain dataclasses are frozen, nested mappings and sequences are recursively snapshotted, B0/B1 and final VEC fields match architecture section 5.3, and knowledge, projection, review, evidence, and release schemas are explicitly bounded for downstream tasks.

checks.name: legacy_read_adapter_only
checks.evidence: The compatibility boundary imports no legacy runtime module, performs only a one-way historical B0/K2 read, derives the missing canonical B0 gaze and continuity fields, and emits a canonical BlockingDraft envelope with provenance.

review.finding: The prior A1 implementation passed a narrow seven-test contract but remained structurally incomplete against architecture v2.1: B0/B1 schemas omitted authority-bearing fields, the final VEC graph was underspecified, nested payload aliases could mutate after hashing, ID inputs could collide at delimiters, and envelopes did not bind a canonical payload class to its ArtifactKind.
review.root_cause: The earlier construction encoded a minimal compatibility-shaped model instead of freezing the complete architecture-owned domain boundary before downstream work consumed it.

considered_options.option: Keep the narrow A1 schema and repair mismatches in A4-A10
considered_options.reason: That would let downstream packages invent parallel authority and would preserve schema drift at the root.

considered_options.option: Adopt historical director_vnext1 or legacy pipeline types as canonical
considered_options.reason: Historical types belong to invalidated or read-only paths and cannot override the v2.1 architecture package.

considered_options.option: Freeze the complete architecture-aligned domain now and force downstream revalidation against it
considered_options.reason: A1 owns the domain boundary. Fixing it here preserves the intended architecture and makes later incompatibilities fail closed instead of being hidden by adapters.

review.residual_risk: A2 and A3 are invalidated and must be revalidated against these expanded canonical schemas. In particular, A3's historical service-local KnowledgeDecisionView and KnowledgeSnapshot definitions must be removed or replaced with imports from mode_p_vnext.domain. No downstream task, shadow run, media run, owner approval, or production switch is authorized by this A1 result.

informational_results.name: a1_test_first_red
informational_results.result: 5 failed, 6 passed before implementation; failures covered B0, B1 decisions, final VEC authority, deep immutability, and ID collision.

informational_results.name: a1_compile_and_patch_check
informational_results.command: python -m compileall -q mode_p_vnext/domain mode_p_vnext/compat; git diff --check
informational_results.result: Canonical domain and compatibility modules compile; no whitespace errors were found.
